# IFC support matrix

Support levels per schema family. **Full** means the entity is interpreted according to the specification;
**Partial** lists the limitations; **No** means the item is reported as `GEOMETRY_UNSUPPORTED` for that product
while the rest of the model keeps loading; **—** means the entity does not exist in that schema.

The table is enforced by `tests/unit/support-matrix.test.ts`: every representation item marked as supported
must be handled by the geometry dispatcher.

## Placements and coordinate systems

| Entity | IFC2X3 | IFC4 | IFC4X3 | Phase | Limitations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| IfcLocalPlacement | Full | Full | Full | MVP | Cycles and chains deeper than maxPlacementDepth are reported and the product is skipped |
| IfcAxis2Placement3D | Full | Full | Full | MVP |  |
| IfcAxis2Placement2D | Full | Full | Full | MVP |  |
| IfcAxis1Placement | Full | Full | Full | v1 |  |
| IfcGridPlacement | Partial | Partial | Partial | v1 | Grid axes must be straight lines or polylines |
| IfcLinearPlacement | — | — | Partial | v2 | Uses CartesianPosition; alignment-based evaluation is not implemented |
| IfcGeometricRepresentationContext.WorldCoordinateSystem | Full | Full | Full | v1 |  |

## Instancing

| Entity | IFC2X3 | IFC4 | IFC4X3 | Phase | Limitations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| IfcCartesianTransformationOperator3D | Full | Full | Full | MVP | Mirroring through Axis2 and non-uniform scale are honoured |
| IfcCartesianTransformationOperator3DnonUniform | Full | Full | Full | v1 |  |
| IfcMappedItem / IfcRepresentationMap | Full | Full | Full | MVP | Maps used at least twice are GPU-instanced; hosts with openings are baked |

## Curves

| IfcIndexedPolyCurve | — | Full | Full | MVP | IfcLineIndex and IfcArcIndex segments |
